rationale: A unanimous reversal is likely to be written narrowly to preserve §1028A’s limiting “during and in relation to” function, adopting a Smith-style non-incidental “purpose or effect” nexus and treating accurate patient identifiers as mere routing information when the fraud is about services/coding. Roberts is best positioned to hold the coalition with a workability/proportionality-focused textual opinion, with separate concurrences most likely from Gorsuch (lenity/text) and Thomas (ordinary meaning/originalism).
